notes: The reported event counts and randomized denominators match the served row. The results abstract separately reports a prespecified on-treatment analysis (placebo, 61/148 patients [41.2%]; colchicine, 38/141 patients [27.0%]); those are not the served observations. The window is the planned POAF assessment in the design abstract; the results abstract does not explicitly state the AF assessment window.
